This is a limited-data assessment. Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset, and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and is labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.
Real official data point: Seebach sits in Kreis 11, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average burglary rate of 3.01 per 1,000 residents there across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 92% of the 12-district average of 3.26/1,000. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for Seebach specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.

Frequently asked questions

Is Seebach safe?

Wandroz currently rates Seebach in Zurich as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich, both by day and after dark. This is a limited-data assessment: Zurich publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is Seebach safe at night?

At night, Seebach is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Seebach a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Seebach's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there any official crime data for Seebach?

Partially. Seebach sits in Kreis 11, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich publishes a real, current burglary rate for that district — 3.01 break-ins a year per 1,000 premises (homes and workplaces), 92% of the 12-district average. This covers burglaries only, not all crime types, and is reported at district level, not specifically for Seebach — see the box below for the full figure and caveats. The neighbourhood-wide rating above is still the limited-data assessment described above, not derived from this burglary figure.
